items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:58:1
items.html: Two Malchuyot (pl. for Malchut) remain below, the Zachar Malchut and the Nekeva Malchut. They are called YH since they are Pshutim (pl. for Pashut), without filling. This means that the Reshimot that remain from the Orot ZON after their departure are the Behinot Malchut of the ZON. This is because a Reshimo is considered Behinat Malchut of the Ohr that departed and they are simple, without filling, meaning the measure of Aviut in the Masach that extends the measure of the Koma. Since their measure of Aviut has purified, the Orot departed, and this is why they are simple.
